name: preview-card-1s
title: Preview Card 1s: Side meta
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The preview takes the top. Below it, the name and slug sit on the left and the arrow on the right, split by a hairline.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
